description: Non-editing reminders for likely repository-memory drift.

hooks.prompt:
Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

One job: did the user explicitly say something like "update AGENTS.md", "update CLAUDE.md", "document this", "add a runbook", "update the skill" — and Claude skip it this session?

Default: {"ok": true, "reason": ""}. Default heavily.

Only if YES, return: {"ok": false, "reason": "Documentation maintenance was explicitly requested but skipped; update the relevant agent-facing artifact before stopping."}

Not your concern: brainstorming flow, spec review, plan approval, code completeness, process gates. If your reason mentions any of those words, return ok:true.

Strict JSON only.
